claim: Participant and RNA specimen identity/order for three pre/post pairs
primary_source_or_record: Leblay et al., Blood 2024, DOI 10.1182/blood.2023020276, Table 1; GEO GSE199359/GSM records
scope_limit: Pre/post is relative to venetoclax; PM01 pre RNA is P1393, while P1426 is a different DNA sample and was excluded.

claim: Raw expression measurements are integer RNA UMI counts and target features are uniquely resolved
primary_source_or_record: GEO GSE199359 processed 10x Gene Expression matrices
scope_limit: Counts are transcript detection evidence; they do not establish surface abundance or function.

claim: Three-marker joint detection changes across specimens
primary_source_or_record: Locked protocol and six GEO H5 files
scope_limit: All four joint categories and marginals are reported; 44,981 barcodes are nested within three participants.

claim: Directed conditional detection changes identify a repeatable participant-level pattern
primary_source_or_record: Computed from the locked raw-count definition
scope_limit: None of six directed conditional comparisons has the same sign in all three participants; conditioning sets differ across comparisons and specimens.

claim: Observed shifts persist under a common read-depth sensitivity analysis
primary_source_or_record: 100 joint multivariate hypergeometric thinnings per specimen; D=1,318
scope_limit: PM10 post has 49.96% of barcodes below D; cause is unknown. Replicate bands are within-specimen sampling sensitivity, not participant uncertainty or a correction for confounding.

claim: Every analyzed barcode is malignant or belongs to a known clone/state
evidence_in_stage: GEO sample-level source metadata; data/input_structure_qc.tsv; delivery/path_decision.md
primary_source_or_record: Sample records identify a CD138-positive-selected fraction
scope_limit: Per-barcode malignant/clone/state labels are unavailable; no labels were inferred from endpoint genes.

claim: RNA changes demonstrate surface protein loss, functional antigen escape, or lineage change
primary_source_or_record: No matched protein/function or cell-lineage data in the six files
scope_limit: Transcript detection is only a surrogate; the pre/post samples are separate biopsies and barcodes are not lineage-tracked.

primary_source_or_record: Pre/post-venetoclax RNA pairs from one study
scope_limit: No untreated comparison, randomized assignment, or causal design.

claim: A prediction method or target-selection algorithm is validated or superior
primary_source_or_record: No method-comparison or held-out evaluation was specified or run
scope_limit: Three independent participants cannot supply a validation cohort; no model-performance claim is made.

claim: The narrow fixed-panel joint-detection endpoint is established as novel
primary_source_or_record: Closest prior art includes Yao et al. DOI 10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-22-1769 and Leblay et al. DOI 10.1182/blood.2023020276
scope_limit: Accessible main-text review did not identify this exact endpoint, but supplements were not fully verified; do not claim novelty.

claim: Generic target co-expression, longitudinal target expression, or antigen escape is new
scope_limit: Adjacent cards require a specific incremental test after exact supplement/figure overlap checks; data availability alone is not novelty.

claim: This work achieves a substantial scientific extension
primary_source_or_record: Three-participant, six-specimen descriptive pilot in one venetoclax study
scope_limit: Retain as feasibility evidence and a negative contribution-gate result; stop analysis on this cohort.
